title: Baby Peering Over Rustic Table on Porch, 1930s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming early 20th-century black-and-white snapshot depicting an inquisitive baby or toddler leaning on a tall, rustic wooden table covered with a light cloth. The photograph is taken on an enclosed porch or sunroom, characterized by a beadboard ceiling, multi-pane glass door, a window outfitted with horizontal blinds, and a dried decorative gourd hanging on the wall. The tall format and stamped production number on the reverse are typical of early 1930s domestic photography.
